channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about DeJuan Blair | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about DeJuan Blair from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on DeJuan Blair
item.description:
“DeJuan gives us a tough inside presence who can score and rebound at both frontcourt positions,”

Ernie Grunfeld on DeJuan Blair, Jul 16, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on DeJuan Blair
item.description:
“He’s got a little time to heal. It’s going to be evaluated weekly. It could have been a lot worse. “(We’ll have to) plug other guys in. Now Blair becomes more at the forefront. Sarge has to be ready. Sam has to keep playing like he did the other night. And it gives guys like Balkman and Melo to get more minutes in the preseason.”

Rick Carlisle on DeJuan Blair, Oct 12, 2013. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Mark Cuban on DeJuan Blair
item.description:
“We already know what DeJuan is going to do to the Spurs. It’s going to be a beautiful thing.”

Mark Cuban on DeJuan Blair, Aug 21, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.
